messages.content: Legal experts generally agree that the decision reversed the precedent set in *Roe v. Wade* and *Planned Parenthood v. Casey*, which grounded abortion rights in the Constitution. Formally, the Court determined that the right to abortion is not explicitly protected under the Due Process Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment. This officially shifted the legal question from a federal constitutional right to a matter of state regulation and constitutionality.
